The '''Chu-Gon Dar Ruins''' were the ruins of ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] buildings located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="SWG:ToOW" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Chu-Gon Dar Ruins were a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ToOW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Chu-Gon Dar Ruins were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:ToOW" />
